pattern.description: The existing 'Avoid downtime' icon and label shrink and slide right to open the centre slot; a dollar coin flips in edge-on (Y-rotation) and scales up, 'Reduce costs' rises in beneath it, and short burst rays pop around the coin as it settles. 'Speed up' on the left stays put.
pattern.why_premium: The current hero hands its centre slot to the new benefit in one continuous move instead of a cut, so the viewer reads a growing three-item list; the edge-on coin flip and the late ray burst give the new item a tactile, celebratory landing.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to([downtimeIcon, downtimeLabel], {x: '+=320', scale: 0.55, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo(coin, {rotationY: 90, scale: 0.6, autoAlpha: 0}, {rotationY: 0, scale: 1, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'back.out(1.4)'}, '<0.15'); tl.fromTo(reduceLabel, {y: 30, autoAlpha: 0}, {y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.1'); tl.fromTo(rays, {scale: 0, autoAlpha: 0}, {scale: 1, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'back.out(2)', stagger: {each: 0.02, from: 'center'}}, '-=0.1');
build_hint.remotion: Shift/shrink the old hero with interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); coin rotateY 90deg->0 and scale 0.6->1 via spring({frame: frame - 4, fps, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}); label translateY 30->0 + opacity with Easing.out(Easing.cubic) from frame 7; rays scale 0->1 via spring({frame: frame - 14, fps, config: {damping: 10, stiffness: 220}}) with 1-frame stagger.

notes: Coin outer ring and seven of eight rays have no own candidate box; b04 ($ glyph) stands for the coin and b08 (left ray) for the ray burst. Pattern could also be read as stagger_list_reveal (third benefit added); layout_reframe chosen because existing items resize/shift together. No SFX candidates; spectrogram shows only rhythmic music hits.
